crop.notes: One column of the Post-Dispatch's 'Going to the Fight' New Orleans report; the headline and start are in the previous column and the end runs to another page. A strip of a dry-goods ad is stuck on the top. The Allen passage is complete.

title.suggested: Tom Allen picks Kilrain to win

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported from New Orleans that Tom Allen, Joe Coburn and Tom Kelly were there for the Sullivan-Kilrain fight and all picked Kilrain. Allen said he must be good or the big money would not be staked on him.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Monday, July 8, 1889, page 2 (Second Extra, after Sullivan won in the 75th round).

facts.fact: Allen was in New Orleans with Joe Coburn and Tom Kelly for the Sullivan-Kilrain fight
Allen predicted Kilrain would beat Sullivan
facts.quote: He is a good un, or the big money would not be staked for him.

notes: Allen gets two short paragraphs in a long fight report, so passing rather than secondary. Same trip as 770.
